name: Barflex Polyfilms Ltd
about: Incorporated in January 2005, Barflex Polyfilms Limited manufactures COEX films, laminates, and labels.[1]
keyPoints:
** Business Overview**[1]
Barflex Polyfilms Limited specializes in manufacturing flexible packaging materials. Its products cater to industries such as FMCG, processed foods, adhesives, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, and construction.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Earnings include an other income of Rs.6.75 Cr.
Debtor days have increased from 53.8 to 66.3 days.
Working capital days have increased from 74.6 days to 110 days
